1,000 draws/cell; count errors are independent Gaussian, not clipped or redrawn. Invalid full draws or any invalid replicate count as noncoverage. Bias/SD diagnostics condition on valid draws. The corrected estimate is I - 4(mean(Ir)-I), with the same raw-replicate SE, without clipping corrected indices or confidence limits.

The experiment assesses two declared groups, matched-pair fixed tract populations, 20/100 tracts, and CV .15 for acceptance. CV .30 is informational. Multigroup H and county/release contrasts have computational tests, not separate coverage experiments. See the frozen criterion for full conventions.
